value.name: Lucia reveals folded paper
value.description: Lucia takes a folded paper from under her blouse and places it beside Asha's wrist, lingering before letting go.
evidence: Lucia drew the folded paper out from under her blouse, the edge of it warm and creased into the shape of her ribs, and set it down on the desk beside Asha's wrist without letting go all at once, her fingertips resting on the fold a breath longer before she lifted them away.

value.name: Asha produces matching sheet
value.description: Asha draws out her own folded sheet and lays it beside Lucia's while keeping her hands visible.
evidence: Asha drew the folded sheet from her cuff and laid it flat beside Lucia's, the two papers almost touching at their long edges, and kept her palms open on the desk where both women could see them.

value.name: Asha challenges the papers to match
value.description: Asha quietly proposes comparing the two documents to see whether they correspond.
evidence: "Now," she said, low enough that the radiator's tick stayed audible under it, "let us see if they match."

value.name: Lucia inspects the documents closely
value.description: Lucia steps closer and studies the paragraph naming the house and the handwriting on her own page.
evidence: Lucia took another half-step in, close enough now that her hip nearly grazed the desk, and her eyes moved from the paragraph naming the house to the looser hand on her own page and back, her fingers still half-curled as if she had not entirely let the second sheet go.

value.name: Rosa hangs back silently
value.description: Rosa remains just behind Lucia, keeping close without touching her and staying silent about the buried woman.
evidence: Rosa kept her place a pace behind, hand fallen from Lucia's shoulder but not far, and none of them spoke yet about which of the two hands belonged to the woman they had buried.

value.name: Lucia unfolds her paper fully
value.description: Lucia opens her paper the rest of the way and smooths its crease before letting her hand drop away.
evidence: Lucia drew the paper open the rest of the way, smoothing the last fold with the side of her thumb, though her fingertips stayed on the crease a beat longer than they needed to before she let her hand fall to the edge of the desk.

value.name: Asha aligns the two pages
value.description: Asha slides the papers flush together and aligns their margins under the lamp before locking eyes with Lucia.
evidence: Asha set her index finger between the two sheets and slid them flush at the long edge, lining the margins until the paragraphs sat parallel under the lamp, then lifted her eyes to Lucia's and held them.

value.name: Rosa moves in behind them
value.description: Rosa steps forward from behind the others, closing the distance as the comparison continues.
